author: Hola
body:
Hi! I'm Lyyris and I'm LFT as a scrim sub. I play for the avicus team iloominatey and am a starter there, but would like to help other teams out by subbing in for them in scrims. I'm 14 years old, not a squeker and I have a mic. If you're interested add me on skype; It's McLyyris but include your IGN into your contact request. 
Preferred positions:
Defensive front liner/support or rusher.

Sorry for the messy LFT, I'm awful at formatting. EDIT: And of course... The spaces between the sentences broke ._.

Pros: 
- Archery, I'm good at ranges between 40-50 blocks and I specialize at bowspam (Shooting moving targets between 5-10 blocks)

- A strong cannoneer.

- Rushing, I can do parkour.

- Communication, I make a lot of call outs and let people know what's going on around the field, but I only talk when needed. I also remain calm in nearly every situation.

I'm mature and won't joke around in scrims.
Cons:
- Melee combat, I can handle some people but I can't say that I would be good at melee.

- Can get annoyed at immature people on my team, might act really "cold" to some people if they have managed to annoy me.

- Defending, I suck at it.

- Timezone, I live in Finland which is GMT+2 so I won't be able to make it to scrims in some of the US times.

- Ping, I get an average of 300 ping to avicus and it might make it harder for me to get knockback to people etc.
